page.layout: One page: a digitiser's cover sheet, no printed text block. Top right the e-rara logo; centred the digitiser's title block; below it the usage notes in four languages; bottom right the Visual Library logo.
page.notes: Digitiser's cover sheet, not a page of the printed book. Omitted as page furniture: the e-rara and Visual Library logos, the digitiser's web links and the usage notes. For reference only, the title block gives: "Dissertatio philologico-isagogica ad chronologiam s. et eccles. prima, de tempore in genere, die et septimana", Rodolph, Johann Rudolph, Bernae, 1684, Universitätsbibliothek Bern.
